name: Zygmunt Bauman
shortBio: Polish-British sociologist and philosopher; theorized 'liquid modernity' where human bonds, institutions, and identities dissolve into precarious and fleeting forms.
centralQuestion: How does the fluid, precarious nature of consumerist liquid modernity dissolve lasting human solidarity and moral commitment?

keyWorks.title: Modernity and the Holocaust
keyWorks.description: Argues the Holocaust was not a breakdown of modernity, but a product of bureaucratic rationalization.

keyWorks.title: Liquid Modernity
keyWorks.description: Diagnoses the shift from hardware-solid modernity to software-liquid consumption.
